headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with over 50% revenue growth, driven by AI‑focused services. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue guidance after barely 1.5% YoY growth. Most peers posted double‑digit growth, but profit margins varied and some guidance remained unchanged.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% YoY, while HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% guidance.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to a low range.
